purpose: learn established-market catalyst DNA at both market and unique-symbol levels without hindsight leakage
history_rule: only observations already collected by Wallet500 are used; unavailable historical catalysts are never invented
counting_rule: market_profiles are exchange:symbol observations; unique_symbols_count is the deduplicated symbol universe
consensus_method: symbol-level aggregation across exchanges; consensus features require >=50% support or >=2 markets, with single-market symbols retained transparently
